name: PostgreSQL

getPSDEDataQueryCodeConds.customCond: ( ( ( t1."scope_id" = #{ctx.sessioncontext.srfpersonid}  AND  t1."scope_type" = 'user' )  OR  t1."create_man" = 'srfpersonid'  OR  t1."update_man" = #{ctx.sessioncontext.srfpersonid} ) )
getPSDEDataQueryCodeConds.name: 查询条件

queryCode:
SELECT
t1."create_man",
t1."create_time",
t1."id",
t1."name",
t1."scope_id",
t1."scope_type",
t1."update_man",
t1."update_time"
FROM "keyrings" t1
